name: cron_outage_watchdog_n8n_lq1556_20261109
comment: INC-261109-ysqqrk (2026-11-09): cron_outage_watchdog raised a false P1 for event-detector because it
read only the cron wrapper journal and the lane's JSON receipt. event-detector is executed by the n8n
dispatcher (dispatch block, 157 ACTIVE lanes), which records RUN_DONE in the coordination ledger and
writes no wrapper completion: the ledger holds live exit-0 RUN_DONE at 12:00:29Z (07:00 ET) and
14:02:18Z (09:02 ET) that day, while the last receipt ok_at was 2026-11-08T08:33:45Z. The reader now
counts runs rows (state RUN_DONE, mode live, exit_code 0, requested_at inside two elapsed opportunities
of the longest cadence + 1 h) as validated_success, read over the runs_state_requested_at index with
mode=ro. Pins: cron-only evidence still grades MISSED_RUNS for the two elapsed fires (fail-before);
the ledger row flips it to OK with last_success_at = the ledger finish instant; dry_run, RUN_FAILED,
exit 1, RUN_SKIPPED_LOCK, future, unregistered and paused rows are never success; an absent ledger
leaves cron evidence untouched; a present-but-corrupt ledger is a collection gap and the lane stays
MISSED (fail toward alerting). Synthetic registry, synthetic ledger built by the real migration.
